name: Nickel
note: Brazil (Anglo American Barro Alto), Colombia (Cerro Matoso).
uses: Stainless steel is the main use; nickel-rich cathodes for electric-vehicle batteries are the growing one.
why_it_matters: Battery-grade nickel sulphate is a bottleneck of the transition; the region's laterite and sulphide deposits (Brazil, Colombia, Guyana, Venezuela) sit beside a processing industry led by Chinese and Indonesian capacity.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
